tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind panels; also the fill of inputs, checkboxes and the hover row in menus (inputs sit one step below their panel).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, dialogs, sheets, popovers and the selected nav item.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surface (well above 7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text: help copy, timestamps, footer status, empty states. On surface it holds 4.8:1 (light). On bg in light it measures ~4.4:1 — just under 4.5:1, kept exact from source; prefer muted text on surface, or use it at 14px+ semibold on bg.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline 1px borders on panels, inputs, rows and dividers. Decorative separation only — interactive state is carried by accent, not line.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand green: primary button fill, links, text buttons, checked controls, selected provider cards, focus rings, graph nodes. Link text on surface and bg holds 6.5:1 (light).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button). Literal white in light, deep green in dark because the dark accent is light.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive menu items and destructive actions. Always paired with words, never color alone.

tokens.name: color-background
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (bg-background): dialog, sheet and tab-active fills.

tokens.name: color-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (text-foreground).

tokens.name: color-popover
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias: dropdown and select content.

tokens.name: color-popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias: text inside popovers.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (border): default border color of generated primitives.

tokens.name: color-ring
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (ring): focus rings on dialog close, tabs, sheet close.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (bg-accent) — NOT the brand accent: the quiet hover/highlight fill for menu items and the TabsList track.

tokens.name: color-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias: text on color-accent.

tokens.name: color-muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (text-muted-foreground): descriptions, shortcuts, menu icons.

tokens.name: color-destructive
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (text-destructive): destructive menu items.

tokens.name: color-input
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (border-input): outline and input borders.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (bg-primary, text-primary): the brand green. Use this, not color-accent, for brand emphasis such as selected state and positive change.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (same values as on-accent).

tokens.name: color-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (text-primary-foreground).

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (bg-secondary): quiet secondary button and chip fill.

tokens.name: color-secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias: text on color-secondary.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a destructive fill.

tokens.name: color-destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (text-destructive-foreground).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series (brand green).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series; series cycle after five. Chart grid, axes and tooltips use line, muted, surface and text.

families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The one h1 per page/panel. Source: clamp(27px, 5vw, 36px); 36px is the desktop cap, 27px the mobile floor.

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.usage: Dialog, AlertDialog and Sheet titles (shadcn text-lg font-semibold).

styles.name: brand-name
styles.usage: The wordmark in the top bar. There is no logo file; the name in this style IS the mark.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a page title (.brand), in accent.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Events shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Occurred, observed, and valid times are separate.
styles.usage: Default body copy and control text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Menu items, settings sub-nav, dialog descriptions, error messages.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Status values and secondary metadata, in muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Connection status does not indicate source freshness.
styles.usage: Connection footer and settings detail links, in muted.

spacing.note: DESIGN_SYSTEM.md fixes the scale at 4/8/12/16/24/32px. The legacy CSS still uses in-between steps (5, 7, 9, 14, 17, 18, 34px); new work snaps to this scale.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Menu/select content padding; icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in an action row; menu item padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; gap between status cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; row vertical padding; status-card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Shell padding; dialog padding; gap between nav column and main.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Content-panel padding at desktop (source clamps 20px–34px).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons, inputs, select triggers and theme options — the touch target.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: Desktop workspace nav column; collapses to a horizontal scroller under 720px.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Top-level content panels, auth panel, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Command palette dialog.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sub-panels, status cards, empty states, graph frame (Tailwind rounded-lg; also Dialog content).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Source provider tiles and sync-history boxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, select triggers, nav items, popovers, theme options (Tailwind rounded-md).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Select and menu items inside a popover (Tailwind rounded-sm).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox box.

shadow.note: Borders do the separating; shadows are reserved for raised surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Auth/status panel — a barely-there lift.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Select content and dropdown menus.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Command palette and modal dialogs.
